bush_angler.text: Bradán is the Irish word for salmon. They come up the Bush every year, same as they have for thousands.
Parrlet are the young ones, small and striped. Patience pays with those. It pays with most things, though not on the bus.
The river is quick and clear. If you hear splashing, it is either a salmon or my wife's dog going in after one. Probably the salmon.
